call_definition.saved_json_load: One grouped B1/C2B JSON bundle load (1).
call_definition.input_load: Saved original h/g/constant snapshot NPZ load (1).
call_definition.sector_context: Existing SectorCAR with 4 spatial orbitals, sector36 (1).
call_definition.arm_arrays_load: One grouped load per arm: J/U, saved generators/corrected reference, ground and bit mapping (2).
call_definition.arm_replay: Existing prepare_arm/configure and fixed component-table correspondence per arm (2).
call_definition.atom_context: Existing atom_operators for all 216 atoms per arm (2).
call_definition.atom_audit: Grouped all-atom Hermiticity/involution, mass, raw-tail and C2B ideal-target checks per arm (2).
call_definition.event_mean: All 216 explicit K0 event_unitary evaluations and their weighted mean per arm (2); no random trajectory sampling.
call_definition.head_reference: Two ordered half-heads with a shared exponential cache per arm (2).
call_definition.kernel_bridge: One h-step mean versus saved corrected/raw CAR reference per arm (2).
call_definition.round_bridge: Two arms times 13 rounds (26): powers, numerical norms, saved signal replay and C2B attachment. No PF/exact-H error recalculation.
call_definition.arm_summary: One numerical/unqualified bridge summary per arm (2).

classification.correctness_PASS: All saved identity and component/normalization/signal replay gates meet the predeclared pilot allowances.
classification.pilot: Operator2/Frobenius/signal bridge distances in sector36 are binary64 observations, not rounding enclosures.
classification.conditional_law: C2B IID53bit model and common exact unitary-map assumptions are retained; this is not the complete implemented law.
classification.unresolved: Rigorous bridge/reference error, whole-P0 synthesis, PCG64 independence, cost support, CA and guaranteed shots/resources remain unresolved.
classification.FAIL: SOURCE, input, spin, frame, sign, phase, normalization, saved reference or signal mismatch stops dependent work and preserves partial evidence.

stop: SOURCE/input/provenance or correctness gate FAIL: stop dependent calls and preserve partial evidence.
Both-arm local kernel gates precede all 26 round evaluations.
Observed bridge distance is not a strict bound; never zero-fill reference/synthesis or upgrade C1.
No automatic rank/fit changes, compiler changes, sampling, C2A/C1 reanalysis, fallback, retry or resume.
Publish and verify remote SHA/artifacts, then mandatory STOP.
scientific_permission: Separate explicit user chat permission is required for this fixed 47-call Bridge evaluation; no approval proof/record/grant is required.
limitation: Even if all numerical gates PASS, rigorous bridge bounds and whole-P0 synthesis remain unknown. This contract does not qualify C1 evidence or same-CA resource superiority.
